summary: Clean refactor extracting the non-database-attribute list into a Field.non_db_attrs class attribute and adding 'choices', correctly making AlterField a noop on SQLite when only choices change. Matches established Django design and resolves the issue generally, not just for the test case.

issues.description: New public-ish Field.non_db_attrs attribute is an extension point (subclasses/3rd-party fields can override) but gets only an inline comment; a brief note in docs would help, though not merge-blocking.
